offline: You are offline. Only the app shell is available; pages that need the server will not load.

landing.title: One content in. Many channel-ready formats out.
landing.subtitle: ContentFlow AI turns a text or a transcript into a library of materials adapted to each channel, and tells you exactly what was processed for real and what is a template-based suggestion.
landing.honest: No generative AI is called by default. Outputs are labeled "template" or, in the future, "AI". Audio and video are not processed on our servers.
landing.limitsLink: Read what the product does not do

project.sourceHint: Paste text or open a .txt, .md, .docx, .pdf, .csv or .json file. Files are read in your browser; only the extracted text is stored (the file itself is not uploaded).
project.algorithms: Computed in your browser: language {{lang}}, keywords {{kw}}, summary {{sum}}. These are classic statistical methods, not generative AI.
project.stale: The text changed since the last analysis. Save and analyze again before generating.
